attchmntText: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: NATCO Pharma Limited filed a notice regarding newspaper publications of its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, and the record date for the second interim dividend for the fiscal year ending 2026-27. The publications appeared on November 14, 2026, in Business Line, Financial Express, and Nava Telangana. The documents are available on the company website at www.natcopharma.co.in. The filing was submitted by Ch. Venkat Ramesh, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: NATCO Pharma Limited has provided the audio weblink for its earnings conference call held on 13th November 2026. The call was for the second quarter of the fiscal year 2027. The audio recording is available on the company's website at the specified URL. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The notice was issued by Ch. Venkat Ramesh, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: NATCO Pharma Limited filed its Q2 FY27 earnings presentation with BSE and NSE on 13th November 2026. Consolidated total revenue stood at INR 10,194 Mn. EBITDA was INR 3,100 Mn with a margin of 30.4%. Profit after share of profit of associate was INR 2,026 Mn. Earnings per share were INR 11.31. International formulations revenue was INR 6,684 Mn. Domestic formulations revenue was INR 1,457 Mn. The company acquired an additional 13.25% stake in Adcock Ingram Holding Limited, bringing total holdings to 49%. Profit share from Adcock Ingram was INR 292 Mn. NATCO invested an additional US$ 16.7 million in eGenesis, Inc., making the total investment US$ 24.7 million. An earnings call was scheduled for 13th November 2026 at 4.00 PM IST.

attchmntText: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 19-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: NATCO Pharma Limited declared a second interim dividend of Rs. 1.25 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The record date for shareholders eligible to receive this dividend is Thursday, 19th November, 2026. Payment of the dividend will commence on 27th November, 2026. The announcement was issued by the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Ch. Venkat Ramesh, following a Board of Directors meeting held on 13th November, 2026.

attchmntText: Natco Pharma Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026 and declaration of 2nd Interim Dividend for FY 2026-27
voiceSummary: NATCO Pharma Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company declared a second interim dividend of Rs. 1.25 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The record date for this dividend is fixed as November 19, 2026. Payment of the dividend will commence on November 27, 2026. The financial results include a Limited Review Report from the Statutory Auditors.
